instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie chest-first against the pad.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down, palms facing each other.
3. Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
4. Hold briefly with arms parallel to the floor.
5. Lower the dumbbells back down with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use light weight and let the chest support remove all momentum.
2. Keep a slight bend in the elbows and lead with the rear shoulders, not the hands.
3. Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top.
4. Move slowly to keep tension on the rear delts.
name: Dumbbell Incline Rear Lateral Raise

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie chest-first against the pad.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging down, palms facing down.
3. Row both dumbbells back by bending the elbows and pulling them toward your sides.
4. Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells with control until the arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Pull with the back, not the arms, and drive the elbows back.
2. Keep the chest pinned to the pad to remove momentum.
3. Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top of each rep.
4. Use a controlled tempo on the way down.
name: Dumbbell Incline Row

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and sit back against the pad.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended at your sides, palms facing each other.
3. Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears without bending the elbows.
4. Hold briefly at the top.
5. Lower the shoulders back down with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lift the shoulders straight up, not in a circular or forward motion.
2. Keep the arms straight and let the traps do the work.
3. Exhale as you shrug up, inhale as you lower.
4. Use a controlled tempo to avoid swinging.
name: Dumbbell Incline Shrug

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and sit back against the pad.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down, palms facing forward.
3. Curl both dumbbells up toward your shoulders by bending the elbows.
4. Squeeze the biceps at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells with control until the arms are fully extended.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep the upper arms back and still to maximize the stretch on the long head.
2. Lift with the biceps, not the shoulders.
3. Use a slow, controlled tempo and avoid swinging.
4. Keep the wrists straight.
name: Dumbbell Incline Simultaneous Curl

instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to 45 degrees and lie back against the pad.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other, pressed together just above the chest.
3. Press the dumbbells up by extending the arms while keeping them squeezed together.
4. Fully extend the arms at the top.
5. Lower the dumbbells back to the chest with control, keeping them in contact.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Press the dumbbells hard against each other through the whole movement.
2. Keep the elbows tucked toward the torso.
3. Focus on driving with the upper chest.
4. Use a controlled tempo on the lowering phase.
name: Dumbbell Incline Squeeze Press
